about: Real referee decision lines (protocol 1), trimmed to the keys tools/decision_menu.py reads, for tools/test_shandalar_decide.py. Captured 2026-10-04 from live duels against the wizard (core decks, and Pack 8 study decks for the choices). `probes` maps a prepare action to the announcement decision the referee answered it with. `priority_modes` (Pack 8 study deck p8_costs) carries a cast whose `usable_modes` is narrower than its `modes` (Spinning Darkness: only the graveyard-exile mode payable).
